sources.text: The rennet casein examples of the patent, up to where the whey is spun off the curd.

rennetCasein.text: Unlike acid casein, rennet casein is not demineralised: the curd keeps its calcium phosphate, so it is insoluble in water and is not made into caseinate directly. It was the raw material for casein plastics such as Galalith.
